spf.comment: Covers FC Seoul's leading 1:2 away win trajectory and the 1:1 draw script, as Seoul's post-title 3-match league winless run and 26.7% away clean-sheet rate make a single Away Win riskier.

btts.comment: Jeonbuk's 1.72 xG meets Seoul's 26.7% away clean-sheet rate, while Seoul's 1.84 xG attacks Jeonbuk's 1.37 xGA defense.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Seoul's clinical away edge against a scoring host; 1:1 covers Jeonbuk's 68.8% home unbeaten record if finishing waste persists.

goals.comment: 3 goals reflects the open 1:2 venue-supported baseline, while 2 goals aligns with the 25.7% Poisson modal total and tight H2H history.

bqc.comment: Jeonbuk's 68.8% home HT draw rate and five consecutive 0:0 H2H half-times point to a level break before Seoul's second-half quality or a shared draw.
